setup: Owner started in secondary project/environment; browser route handler delayed only project1 GET /admin/v1/budgets requests by 1800 ms, then forwarded them unchanged to the isolated server.

observations.while_loading: FinOps displayed table skeleton placeholders; no secondary-project budget rows remained visible under the newly selected project header.
observations.after_delayed_response: FinOps showed the two persisted rows scoped to project1: its environment and project budgets.
observations.result: PASS for this delayed project-switch render scenario; no stale cross-project rows observed

limitations: Only FinOps Budgets & Holds was tested.
Single owner session, two projects, one 1800 ms delay, Chromium only.
This does not clear DEF-023 or DEF-024 and does not establish race safety for other screens, tabs, permission changes, network errors, or simultaneous refreshes.
